libs.note: BH-5791. The design-collision check at PLAN: the `design collisions` block in bin/lib/rb/plan.sh runs bin/plan-collisions.sh after the plan gate, and checks each symbol under the plan's `## Changed symbols` against main since the plan's base and against every open PR. Read per project through lib_env_apply design-collisions <project> in pc_conf. Doc: docs/notes/2026-10-10-BH-5791-design-collisions.md.

knobs.note: 1 (default): a listed symbol that collides and has no combine or needs-human line under `## Design collisions` gets one repair pass, then the build ends PLAN_BLOCKED. 0|false|no|off: the note is written and the build continues (verdict note-only). Any other value is treated as ON and writes one ALERTS line.

How many open PRs the check lists (one paginated REST list, gh_rest_pr_list_all). 0 = the PR check is off (OPEN_PRS: off) and no GitHub call is made. A value that is not a whole number uses 100 and writes one ALERTS line.

How many symbols the check reads from the plan (listed first, then derived). The note states how many it dropped over the cap. A value that is not a whole number above 0 uses 40 and writes one ALERTS line.
